location_description: Bourbonnais ( BOOR-boh-NAY, bur-BOH-niss) is a village in Kankakee County, Illinois, United States. The population was 18,631 in the 2010 census, but had grown to 19,462 in the 2019 census estimate. It is part of the Kankakee-Bourbonnais-Bradley Metropolitan Statistical Area.
